name: a create's URL counts as created when it is not the last line
command: gh pr create --title "Fix login" --body "Fixes the login form."
output:
Creating pull request for fix-login into main in o/r

https://github.com/o/r/pull/7
Warning: 1 uncommitted change

output:

url:	https://github.com/o/r/pull/12

name: a created PR is not mentioned again
a script that lists and then creates records nothing
command: gh pr list --author @me && gh pr create --fill

name: more URL lines than create commands records none as created
a PR another command names is not created
command: gh pr view 12 --json url -q .url; gh pr create --fill

name: gh pr list inside a quoted string does not suppress
command: echo "next: gh pr list" && gh pr create --fill

name: gh pr list inside a heredoc body does not suppress
command:
cat <<'EOF' > notes.md
gh pr list
EOF
gh pr create --fill --body-file notes.md

name: gh pr list inside a body built from a heredoc does not suppress
command:
gh pr create --title "Add x" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
- Compare with gh pr list --state merged; see #12
EOF
)"
